## 🤖 AI Automation - GHL Lead Pipeline

**Yeh workflow kya karta hai:**

1. 🪝 **GHL Webhook** — Jab bhi koi lead funnel form submit kare, GHL yahan data bhejta hai
2. 📊 **Lead Scoring** — Lead ka score calculate hota hai budget aur business size ke basis pe
   - Hot Lead = 60+ points
   - Warm Lead = 30-59 points
   - Cold Lead = 0-29 points
3. 🔀 **Smart Routing** — Hot leads priority queue mein, cold leads nurture sequence mein
4. 🤖 **AI Message** — OpenRouter (free model) se har lead ke liye personalized message generate hota hai
5. 📊 **Google Sheets** — Sab lead data automatically sheet mein save hota hai

**Setup ke liye:**
- OpenRouter API key add karo HTTP Request node mein
- Google Sheets node mein apni sheet connect karo
- GHL mein webhook URL add karo
